keyframes.name: Michaelis complex
keyframes.caption: Ser105 attacks the ester carbonyl; His224 takes the serine proton.

keyframes.name: Tetrahedral intermediate 1
keyframes.caption: The tetrahedral intermediate collapses; p-nitrophenol leaves with the proton His was holding.

keyframes.name: Acyl-enzyme
keyframes.caption: Water attacks the acyl-enzyme; His224 takes a proton from it.

keyframes.name: Tetrahedral intermediate 2
keyframes.caption: The second tetrahedral intermediate collapses and expels the serine alkoxide.

keyframes.name: Acetic acid and Ser alkoxide
keyframes.caption: His224 returns the proton to Ser105: acetic acid, p-nitrophenol, enzyme restored.

keyframes.name: Resting state
keyframes.caption: Resting state: products present, catalytic residues regenerated.
